name: Brute force / credential stuffing burst
input: Stream of login_failed events grouped by (source_ip) OR (user_id) within a sliding window.

condition.description: 5 or more login_failed events for the same source_ip (or same user_id) within a 5-minute sliding window.

evidence_template: {count} failed authentication attempts from {source_ip} between {first_ts} and {last_ts}
false_positives: User genuinely forgot their password and retried manually (see benign/forgotten-password.json).
Shared NAT/VPN egress IP causing many distinct users to appear as one source_ip.
Automated health-check or monitoring script misconfigured with wrong credentials.
